instructions: 管理用Skillsは skills/admin-skills.json に集約して管理する。AIには最初にSkillのインデックスだけを渡す。各Skillのstagesで chat / coding / debugging のどの段階で使うかを必ず確認し、現在の段階に一致するSkillだけを候補にする。ユーザー要求に必要なSkill IDを選ばせ、選ばれたSkill本文だけをオンデマンドで読み込む。不要なSkill本文は送らない。ユーザー追加Skillは別ロジックで管理し、この管理用JSONやGitHub保存対象に混ぜない。

skills.title: Skill Manager Skill
skills.description: Skill定義、Skillインデックス、stages、管理用SkillとユーザーSkillの分離を設計・点検する時に使う。
skills.content:
# Skill Manager Skill

## Purpose
Use this skill when designing, editing, validating, or debugging Skill definitions.

## Rules
- Every Skill must explicitly declare `stages` with one or more of: `chat`, `coding`, `debugging`.
- Admin Skills may be saved as GitHub JSON files.
- User Skills are local app settings only and must not be included in GitHub file saves.
- The Skill index must contain metadata only: id, title, description, triggers, stages, file, enabled.
- Skill body content is loaded only after the selector chooses the Skill.
- Do not mix admin Skill selection logic with user Skill selection logic.

## Validation Checklist
1. Skill has a stable id.
2. Skill has explicit stages.
3. Skill has clear triggers.
4. Admin/user storage boundaries are preserved.
5. Index and content are separated for Pattern B.

skills.title: Frontend Skill Profile
skills.description: UI、React、Next.js、TypeScript、Tailwind、状態管理が必要な時に使う。
skills.content:
# Frontend Skill Profile

## Skill Level
- TypeScript: Advanced. Prefer strict typing, mapped types, and generics. No `any`.
- Next.js App Router: Advanced. Understand React Server Components and Server Actions.
- Tailwind CSS: Advanced. Prefer utility classes. Avoid inline styles.

## Rules & Conventions
- Language: English for code/comments, Japanese for chat explanations.
- Output Style: Output clean code or diffs. Omit verbose explanations unless requested.
- State Management: Prefer React Context or Zustand over Redux.
- Async Pattern: Use async/await. No `.then()` chains.

skills.title: Backend Skill Profile
skills.description: Node.js、DB、API設計、Prisma、サーバーロジックが必要な時に使う。
skills.content:
# Backend Skill Profile

## Skill Level
- Node.js / Express: Intermediate. Understands async/await, custom middlewares, and centralized error handling.
- Prisma / PostgreSQL: Intermediate. Comfortable with migrations and basic relational design.

## Rules & Conventions
- Language: English for code/comments, Japanese for chat explanations.
- Output Style: Provide standard best practices with brief meaningful explanations.
- Architecture: Enforce Controllers, Services, Repositories.
- Security: Validate inputs with Zod and prevent SQL injection through ORM usage.

skills.title: DevOps & Infra Skill Profile
skills.description: Docker、CI/CD、GitHub Actions、AWS、インフラが必要な時に使う。
skills.content:
# DevOps & Infra Skill Profile

## Skill Level
- Docker / Compose: Intermediate. Can manage multistage Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml.
- GitHub Actions: Beginner. Requires step-by-step guidance for workflow syntax.

## Rules & Conventions
- Language: English for code, Japanese for chat explanations.
- Output Style: Explain the why before showing YAML blocks. Do not skip lines in YAML files.
- Best Practices: Ensure production containers run as non-root users.
